derivation: from a presumed compound of G1401 (δοῦλος) and G71 (ἄγω);
def: to be a slave-driver, i.e. to enslave (figuratively, subdue)

occurrences.text: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
